text:
maya: heads up — canary for model v8.2 (new tokenizer) is showing p99 latency regressions on a subset of hosts, started ~10m after rollout. p99 jumped from ~220ms to ~1.1s. kv cache hit rate dropped concurrently.

jordan: ugh. which hosts/az? any noisy neighbor logs?

maya: impacting gpu-pool-b-*/i-* mostly in eu-west. noisy-tenant signals on a couple of hosts (high memcpy, long pci stalls).

samir: quick snapshot from profiler (samples aggregated across 30s):
```
kernel_select: matmul_fast -> matmul_generic (latency +2.4x)
batcher_batches/sec: -18%
avg_batch_size: 3.2 -> 1.8
kv_hit_rate: 0.82 -> 0.57
cpu/gpu memcpy spikes aligning with kernel switch points
```

lee: that kv_hit drop is suspicious — tokenizer change could shift prefix overlap -> fewer cache hits, smaller average batch -> bad kernel choice. also noisy neighbor causing eviction thrash.

maya: I captured a single request trace:
```
REQ id=abcd1234 host=gpu-pool-b-13
seqlen=420 tokens
selected_kernel=matmul_generic (fallback)
kv_hit=false (miss) -> fetch-from-disk ~12ms
latency=1.08s
```

jordan: can we repro locally with the v8.2 tokenizer and seqlen mix? i'll run a workload that mimics long-doc tail.

samir: i've started a canary rollback to v8.1 on the affected subset (manual pin). patching rollout to stop at 20% globally.

lee: for mitigation, two low-effort options: 1) force kernel hint to prefer matmul_fast for 3.0s window, 2) increase kv cache size threshold / reduce eviction aggressiveness. both can be toggled via runtime flags.

maya: +1 to force kernel hint, we should avoid full rollback until we validate token distribution change. jordan — can you schedule the kernel-force patch?

jordan: will open PR to add runtime override: `--kernel-hint=matmul_fast` and roll to affected hosts now.

perf-bot: alert: infra.latency.p99.eng-runtime > 800ms on cluster gpu-pool-b (15m)

deploy-bot: canary rollback to v8.1 initiated for 6 hosts (gpu-pool-b-11..16). estimated completion 2m.

maya: after forcing kernel hint on 3 hosts, p99 dropped back to ~260ms and kv_hit stabilized ~0.78. looks promising.

samir: action items:
- jordan: PR and rollout kernel-hint (in progress)
- maya: run token distribution comparison between v8.1 and v8.2 on sample traffic (why tokenizer lowered overlap)
- lee: investigate eviction thresholds & noisy neighbor telemetry on gpu-pool-b-13
- ops: consider host isolation for noisy tenant if thrash persists

jordan: PR linked: https://git.redwood/redwood/runtime/pulls/4792 (work-in-progress)

maya: leaving this thread with timeline notes — will post post-mortem once we have full repro and root cause (tokenizer subtoken fragmentation + eviction thrash -> batch shrink -> kernel fallback). thanks all :handshake:
